newsitem.title: USA: Grist Mill sees FY97 EPS of $0.45-$0.50.
newsitem.headline: Grist Mill sees FY97 EPS of $0.45-$0.50.

text.p: Grist Mill Co said Tuesday it sees fiscal year 1997 earnings of $0.45 to $0.50 a share and backs estimates for second quarter earnings of $0.08 a share.
"I think we're going to be in the range of $0.45 to $0.50 (earnings per share) for fiscal year '97," chief financial officer Daniel Kinsella told Reuters after the annual shareholders meeting.
"The consensus for the second quarter is $0.08," he said. "That's about what it should be. We're one month in (the second quarter) and we're in line with their expectations."
In fiscal year 1996 ending May 31, the company earned $0.49 a share and in the second quarter last year it reported earnings of $0.11 a share.
